questions.stem: 要負擔太空旅遊，對一般人來說並不容易，但富豪們卻爭相購票，使票價不斷上漲。
questions.answer: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford space tourism, but the wealthy are rushing to buy tickets, pushing prices ever higher.
accepted_answers: It is difficult for average people to afford space travel, yet wealthy people are competing to buy tickets, driving ticket prices higher and higher.
It is hard for the average person to afford a trip to space, but rich people are scrambling to buy tickets, causing prices to keep rising.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

questions.stem: 送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘，比我們想像中更傷害地球。
questions.answer: Sending a few wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun does more harm to the earth than we imagine.
accepted_answers: Sending a handful of rich people into space for a few minutes of fun harms the planet more than we think.
Flying a small number of wealthy people into space to have fun for a few minutes is more harmful to the earth than we realize.

1.explanation_zh: 「要負擔…，對一般人來說並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy for ordinary people to afford …；afford 是「負擔得起」，直接接 space tourism 或 the cost of …。「但富豪們卻爭相購票」是另一個有實際主詞的子句：the wealthy／the rich 指一群人，動詞用複數 are rushing／competing to buy tickets。「，使票價不斷上漲」是搶票造成的結果，用句尾分詞 pushing prices ever higher 或 causing ticket prices to keep rising。
evidence: 要負擔太空旅遊，對一般人來說並不容易
1.strategy_zh: 句尾表結果的分詞要接在有實際主詞的子句後面（富豪搶票 → 票價上漲），邏輯關係才清楚。
hints: 切成四段：要負擔太空旅遊／對一般人來說並不容易／但富豪們卻爭相購票／使票價不斷上漲
標的詞彙：afford（負擔得起）、tourism（旅遊）、ordinary（一般的）、wealthy（富有的）、ticket（票）、price（價格）
句型框架：It is not easy for sb to VR …, but S + be + V-ing …, pushing／driving／causing + O …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是「送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘」這整個動作，用動名詞片語 Sending a few wealthy people into space for a few minutes of fun 當主詞，動詞用單數。「玩幾分鐘」要把「玩」譯出來：for a few minutes of fun 或 to have fun for a few minutes。「比我們想像中更傷害地球」用比較級：does more harm to the earth（harm 不可數）、harms the earth more 或 is more harmful to the earth，最後接 than we imagine。
evidence: 送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘
比我們想像中更傷害地球
2.strategy_zh: 中文「比 B 更…」的 B 在前面，英文的 than B 要放到比較的內容後面。
hints: 切成四段：送少數富人上太空／玩幾分鐘／比我們想像中／更傷害地球
標的詞彙：wealthy（富有的）、space（太空）、minute（分鐘）、harm（傷害）、earth（地球）、imagine（想像）
句型框架：V-ing … + does more harm to + O + than + S + imagine

1.translation: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford space travel, but the wealthy are competing to buy tickets, causing ticket prices to keep rising.
1.explanation_zh: 「要負擔……對一般人來說並不容易」用 It is not easy for sb to V；「負擔」用 afford；「爭相購票」寫 are competing to buy tickets（現在的趨勢用進行式）；「使票價不斷上漲」是結果，用句尾分詞 causing ticket prices to keep rising。

2.translation: Sending a small number of rich people into space for a few minutes of fun harms the Earth more than we imagine.
2.explanation_zh: 「送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘」當主詞用動名詞片語 Sending…；「玩幾分鐘」寫 for a few minutes of fun；「比我們想像中更傷害地球」用 harms the Earth more than we imagine；為避免 a few…a few 重複，「少數」寫 a small number of。

issues_zh: 本盲譯第 3 部分寫 but the wealthy are competing to buy tickets；accepted 有 but the wealthy are rushing／scrambling to buy tickets、but the wealthy are competing for tickets、but the rich are competing to buy tickets、yet wealthy people are competing to buy tickets，卻沒有這個組合，整句也不等於任何參考譯文，所以 within_accepted 照實填 false。這是 accepted 清單的組合不完整，不是中文有歧義；其餘 3 部分都逐字在 accepted 內。建議補 but the wealthy are competing to buy tickets、but wealthy people are competing to buy tickets、yet the wealthy are competing to buy tickets 等組合（最好把 but／yet × the wealthy／the rich／wealthy people／rich people × rushing／competing／scrambling to buy tickets 系統性展開）。
（小建議，不影響判定）第 4 部分 accepted 的 pushing up prices、driving up prices 等沒有譯出「不斷」，比參考譯文寬鬆；可接受，但若要求「不斷」要有對應，可改成 pushing prices up steadily 之類。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

1.translation: It is not easy for ordinary people to afford space tourism, but wealthy people are scrambling to buy tickets, causing ticket prices to keep rising.
1.explanation_zh: 「要負擔…對一般人來說並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy for ordinary people to afford…；「爭相購票」用 are scrambling to buy tickets（現在進行式表示正在發生的趨勢）；「使票價不斷上漲」用分詞構句 causing ticket prices to keep rising。中文「太空旅遊」我用 space tourism，「富豪們」用 wealthy people，詞彙選擇空間大，所以給 medium。

2.translation: Sending a few wealthy people into space to have fun for a few minutes harms the Earth more than we imagine.
2.explanation_zh: 「送少數富人上太空玩幾分鐘」用動名詞片語當主詞 Sending a few wealthy people into space…（主詞是單一行為，動詞用單數 harms）；「比我們想像中更傷害地球」用比較級 more than we imagine，harm 當及物動詞。
